# Thumbnail

A 64px frame for a product image: 16px corners, 2px white border, hairline shadow. The quantity sits in a black badge hanging 8px off the top corner.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/thumbnail)

## Usage

```tsx
<Thumbnail quantity={2}>
  <img src={product.image} alt="" />
</Thumbnail>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | An &lt;img> or &lt;svg>. It fills the frame. |
| `quantity` | `number` | Number in the badge. Leave out for no badge. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Thumbnail.module.css`
- `Thumbnail.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
